Version and compatibility

Release versions, dates, file sizes and checksums are not published in the current source. Check the downloaded package documentation and contact technical support if the required version or compatibility is unclear. A package filename is not a complete compatibility statement.

Downloads are hosted externally on SharePoint. If a link requires access or fails, send the guide name and package name to support. Do not send credentials.
